309: Aland lists Matthew 10:24 and Luke 6:40 as the sayings-parallels to John 13:16. The source spreadsheet reads “Luke 6.4”, which is almost certainly a typo for 6:40 — shown here as entered.
312: This entry duplicates §310 in the source spreadsheet (same title, same references).
361: 1 Corinthians 15:3–8 is Paul's list of resurrection appearances. Aland prints it here as a citation for comparison — it is not a passage of Mark, though the spreadsheet places it in the Mark column.
362: The Shorter Ending of Mark has no verse numbers: it is a floating paragraph that a handful of manuscripts (L, Ψ, 083, 099, 274 margin, 579, and the Old Latin k) place after Mark 16:8, some instead of the Longer Ending and some before it. It is absent from the KJV and the NIV, which is why no verse text appears in this row. Mark 16:1–8 is not the shorter ending — that is §352, The Women at the Tomb, where it appears in full.
